name: Ham, Spinach & Onion Quiche (crustless)

ingredients.name: shredded cheese (cheddar, Swiss, or Monterey Jack)

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 9-inch dish.
Sauté onion in a little butter or oil 3-4 min, add spinach, cook until wilted. Squeeze out excess liquid.
Whisk eggs, cream, cream cheese, and yogurt until smooth. Season, then stir in 1/2 cup of the cheese.
Spread ham, onion, and spinach in the dish. Pour egg mixture over top.
Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup cheese on top.
Bake 35-40 min until center is set and top is golden.
Rest 5 min before slicing.

name: Mushroom Butter Sauce Chicken & Potatoes
steps: Pat chicken dry, season with salt and pepper. Heat oil over medium-high. Sear chicken skin-side down 5-6 min, flip, sear 4-5 min more. Set aside.
Add 2 tbsp butter, then potatoes (cut-side down first). Cook 6-8 min until starting to soften. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add mushrooms, cook 4-5 min until they release liquid and brown.
Pour in broth, add thyme and remaining 2 tbsp butter. Nestle chicken back in.
Bring to a gentle simmer, reduce to medium-low, cover, and cook 15-18 min until potatoes are tender and chicken hits 165°F.
Squeeze lemon over everything, adjust seasoning. If the sauce is thin, simmer uncovered 2-3 min.

name: Chicken Stroganoff
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high. Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder.
Sear chicken until golden (5-7 min), in batches if needed. Set aside.
In the same pan, sauté mushrooms and onions until soft (5 min). Season.
Lower heat to medium. Stir in sour cream and Parmesan until combined.
Add chicken back, stir gently, simmer 2-3 min.
Cook noodles separately, serve stroganoff on top.

name: Greek Yogurt Protein Parfait Bowls
steps: Mix yogurt, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until smooth.
Toast oats on a baking sheet at 350°F for 8-10 min. Cool.
Toss oats with nuts and honey, spread out, bake 8-10 min more at 350°F until clumped. Cool completely.
Layer into 5 containers: yogurt, granola, berries, more granola on top.
